summary: CAAP filed a 6-K announcing that wholly owned subsidiary Corporacion America Italia S.p.A. acquired 1,077,402 Toscana Aeroporti shares, roughly 5.789% of outstanding capital, from SOGIM for EUR 19.0 million, funded via existing cash and a CAAP capital contribution. The purchase lifts CAAP's indirect economic interest from 62.283% to 68.072% in the Pisa and Florence airport operator, deepening its Italian position. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or closing condition was disclosed. Watch for possible mandatory-tender or minority-squeeze implications, further stake accumulation, and purchase-price allocation against TA's trading value.
